newsitem.title: USA: Hitachi Data Systems sets reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Data Systems sets reorganization.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd's Hitachi Data Systems Monday said it will restructure worldwide operations by consolidating sales and marketing units and streamlining product offerings around its computing, storage, and services business lines.

The move is accompanied by an expansion of the firm's executive committee, led by the naming of Brian Walker, formerly president of the unit's Europe business, as executive vice president of global sales and marketing.

"Many companies are looking for a single interface point around the world, and HDS has it," Walker said in a statement. "HDS can now deal with a customer on a unified basis with one price list and one central set of conditions."
Hitachi Data Systems markets high-performance computer processors, peripheral products, open systems hardware and software, and services.
